objective: Side Quests stop interrupting with a dialog and arrive as a notification a member can switch off.
userOutcome: Turning off Reward updates in Notification settings stops Side Quest nudges for good.
successCriteria: The Side Quest dialog no longer opens on the map.
A claimable Side Quest arrives as a reward notification linking to /rewards.
Reward updates in Notification settings suppresses it, push and in-app alike.
At most one Side Quest notification a day per member.
mustPreserve: Every other notification and its preference.
The Rewards page and how quests are claimed there.
nonGoals: No new notification type and no new preference toggle.
No change to which quests exist or what they pay.

assumptions.statement: A Side Quest nudge is a reward notification, so the existing rewardsEnabled toggle is the switch for it.
assumptions.impact: Members get the requested off switch without a new default being invented.

nextVisibleMilestone: No Side Quest dialog on cruush.app, and the nudge arrives in notifications instead.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.
